description: This Java source file is a Spring MVC controller class named 'ManufacturerController' responsible for handling web requests related to 'Manufacturer' entities in an e-commerce application. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, editing, saving, paginating, and deleting manufacturer records, as well as managing associated user interface elements and data validation.

classes.name: ManufacturerController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller class that manages CRUD operations and views for 'Manufacturer' entities within the admin section of the web application.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of manufacturers.

methods.name: createManufacturer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the form for creating a new manufacturer.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the form for editing an existing manufacturer.

methods.name: displayManufacturer
methods.description: Private method to prepare and display the manufacturer creation/edit form.

methods.name: saveManufacturer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a manufacturer entity, including image validation and localization.

methods.name: pageManufacturers
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide paginated manufacturer data in JSON format.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a manufacturer, ensuring it has no attached products.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set the menu context for the view.
